# Branding

Your public trust center is **your** brand, not ours. Under **Branding** in the builder
you can set:

- **Display name** and **logo** (URL)
- **Headline** and **description**
- **Primary** and **accent** colors
- **Support email**

A live preview shows your header as you edit; open **View public page ↗** to see the
full result at `/trust/{vendor_id}`.

Branding fields are stored on your profile and returned by the public profile endpoint,
so any tool rendering your trust center uses your brand consistently.
